name: Yullia Fok
bio: I'm a certified personal trainer passionate about helping women and fitness beginners discover their strength and confidence through exercise. With over 8 years of experience, I specialize in creating welcoming, non-intimidating fitness experiences that empower my clients to achieve their health goals.
philosophy: My training philosophy is built on three core principles: safety, encouragement, and personalization. I believe that fitness should be accessible to everyone, regardless of experience level. There's no judgment in my sessions - only support, guidance, and celebration of every small victory. My goal is to help you build sustainable habits that enhance your quality of life, both inside and outside the gym.
